questions.question: Name the main parts of an animal's body and say what one of them does.
questions.expected_answer: A head, a body, a tail and limbs, with sense organs mostly on the head. For example, the head holds the brain and mouth; the body holds the heart, lungs and stomach; the tail helps with balance, swimming or swatting flies; limbs help the animal move.

questions.question: Name the five sense organs of a person and what each one does.
questions.expected_answer: Eyes see, ears hear, the nose smells, the tongue tastes, and the skin feels touch, heat and cold.

questions.question: Describe three different body coverings, with an animal for each.
questions.expected_answer: Any three, for example: fur on a lion, feathers on an ostrich, dry scales on a crocodile or snake, wet scales on a fish, a hard shell on a tortoise, smooth wet skin on a frog, a hard outer covering on a beetle.
